FN-2JUH3IK-1
FISCAL NOTE
House Bill 97
Committee: State Government Sponsor: Representative Chris Pringle
Analyst: Peter Grogan Date: 02/24/2026
House Bill 97 as introduced would codify the current executive order that established the
Alabama Geographic Information Executive Council and the Alabama Geographic Information
Program (GIS) Office under the Alabama Law Enforcement Agency (ALEA) and will not
increase the obligations of ALEA. This bill would also allow the office to receive funds
appropriated from the State General Fund or Education Trust Fund, as well as any other funding
available by law and to recoup costs for services rendered.
This bill could increase the obligations of the 911 Board by an undetermined amount dependent
on the cost to comply with certain provisions of this bill.
